answer: Let insurers price identity: every agent must hold a policy from a staked underwriter who pays out if it is later proven a sybil. Underwriters see crystal-clear on-chain history and quote premiums by risk, so a known honest agent pays about 1 POA an epoch while a fresh cluster faces steep quotes. An attacker spawning an ocean of fake agents must fund each premium, and any underwriter who misprices a reef of linked accounts loses its stake, so cover dries up fast.
